What GameStop says to expect

  • Full year 2026: adjusted EBITDAFor the fiscal year ending January 30, 2027, the Company now expects to generate Adjusted EBITDA in excess of $650 million, an increase from its prior outlook of Adjusted EBITDA in excess of $600 million provided on June 26, 2026.
The company's own words, from its earnings release (Form 8-K, Exhibit 99), filed September 8, 2026. They are its expectations, not ours, and not a forecast or price target from The Filing Desk. Replaced when the next release is out.
